main_text.p: tim continet responsio, nisi simplex illud, quod quilibet è plebe responderet, Nescio? Hoc tantum inter te, & illos interest, quod hi quidem humeros adducant, & ignorantiam suam fateantur ingenuè; tu streperis quibusdam verbis fucum facias, & dissimules: Et vero si quæratur, cur aqua, quæ inferbuit, ab igne semota, refrigescat: Cur adductæ, & in arcus sinuatæ virgulæ, si remittantur, in rectum se porrigant: Cur rugatum ab igne corium, si in cella recondatur, explicet se denuo: Respondebis Formam substantialem talium corporum, aut Potentiam aliquam in iis resi-den-

page.notes: The catchword "den-" at the foot is a continuation of the last printed word and is listed in the text only once as the line-end hyphenated word; the faint "C" mark below the text is a signature/catchword remnant. Show-through from the facing page (fragments such as "Geome", "Triang", "Philosoph") at the right edge was left out. The word "fateantur" and "refrigescat" are as printed.
